1.text: “Yemwe bagabo bene Data na ba data, nimwumve amagambo nireguza kuri mwe.”

2.text: Bumvise ababwiye mu Ruheburayo barushaho guceceka. Aravuga ati

3.text: “Ndi Umuyuda wavukiye i Taruso y'i Kilikiya, ariko nakuriye muri uyu murwa, nigishirizwa ku birenge bya Gamaliyeli kwitondera cyane amategeko ya ba sogokuruza yose, ngira ishyaka ry'Imana nk'uko namwe mwese murigira none.

4.text: Kandi narenganyaga ab'iyi Nzira ya Yesu ngo bicwe, nkababoha nkabashyira mu nzu y'imbohe, abagabo n'abagore.

5.text: Kandi n'umutambyi mukuru ni umugabo wanjye w'ibyo, n'abakuru bose b'abanyarukiko na bo ni uko, kuko ari bo bampaye inzandiko zandikiwe bene Data b'i Damasiko, njyanwayo no kuzana n'ab'aho i Yerusalemu ari imbohe kugira ngo bahanwe.

6.text: “Nuko nkigenda ngeze hafi y'i Damasiko, nko ku manywa y'ihangu mbona umucyo mwinshi uvuye mu ijuru untunguye, urangota.

7.text: Nikubita hasi numva ijwi rimbaza riti ‘Sawuli, Sawuli, undenganiriza iki?’

8.text: Nanjye ndabaza nti ‘Uri nde, Mwami?’ Aransubiza ati ‘Ndi Yesu w'i Nazareti uwo urenganya.’

9.text: Abari bari kumwe nanjye babona umucyo, ariko ntibumva ijwi ry'uwo tuvugana.

10.text: Ndamubaza nti ‘Ngire nte, Mwami?’ Umwami aransubiza ati ‘Haguruka ujye i Damasiko, ni ho uzabwirirwa ibyo ugenewe gukora byose.’

11.text: Kandi ubwiza bw'uwo mucyo burampumisha, ni cyo cyatumye ndandatwa n'abo twari turi kumwe njya i Damasiko.

12.text: “Umuntu witwa Ananiya wubahaga Imana, akumvira amategeko kandi yashimwaga n'Abayuda bose bari batuyeyo,

13.text: aransanga ampagarara iruhande arambwira ati ‘Sawuli mwene Data, humuka.’ Uwo mwanya ndahumuka ndamureba.

14.text: Aravuga ati ‘Imana ya ba sogokuruza yagutoranirije kera kumenya ibyo ishaka, no kubona wa Mukiranutsi, no kumva ijwi riva mu kanwa ke,

15.text: kuko uzaba umugabo we wo guhamiriza abantu bose ibyo wabonye n'ibyo wumvise.

16.text: None ikigutinza ni iki? Haguruka ubatizwe, wiyuhagire ibyaha byawe, wambaje izina rye.’

17.text: “Nuko maze gusubira i Yerusalemu ndi mu rusengero nsenga, mba nk'urota

18.text: mbona Yesu ambwira ati ‘Ihute uve i Yerusalemu vuba, kuko batazemera ibyo umpamya.’

19.text: Nanjye nti ‘Mwami, na bo ubwabo bazi yuko nashyiraga abakwizeye mu nzu y'imbohe, nkabakubitira mu masinagogi yose.

20.text: Kandi ubwo bavushaga amaraso ya Sitefano wahamyaga ibyawe, nanjye nari mpari mbyishimiye, ndinda imyenda y'abamwicaga.’

21.text: Aransubiza ati ‘Genda kuko nzagutuma kure mu banyamahanga.’ ”

22.text: Baramwumviriza kugeza kuri iryo jambo, maze bavuga ijwi rirenga bati “Kūra icyo kigabo mu isi, ntigikwiriye kubaho.”

23.text: Barasakuza kandi bajugunya hejuru imyenda yabo, batumurira umukungugu mu kirere,

24.text: bigeza aho umutware w'ingabo abategeka kumwinjiza mu rugo rw'igihome, ababwira kumutatisha ibiboko kugira ngo amenye icyateye abantu kumuvugiriza iyo nduru.

25.text: Bamaze kumubohesha imishumi, Pawulo abaza umutware utwara umutwe wari uhagaze aho ati “Mbese amategeko yemera ko mukubita umuntu w'Umuroma, ari nta rubanza rwamutsinze?”

26.text: Uwo mutware abyumvise ajya kubibwira umutware w'ingabo, aramubaza ati “Urenda gukora iki, ko uyu muntu ari Umuroma?”

27.text: Umutware w'ingabo araza aramubaza ati “Mbwira, mbese uri Umuroma koko?”Na we ati “Yee.”

28.text: Umutware w'ingabo aramusubiza ati “Jyeweho nagombye kugura Uburoma impiya nyinshi.”Pawulo ati “Ariko jyeweho narabuvukanye.”

29.text: Nuko abari bagiye kumutata baherako baramureka, kandi umutware w'ingabo aratinya, amenya yuko ari Umuroma kandi yamuboshye.

30.text: Bukeye bw'aho ashatse kumenya neza icyo Abayuda bamurega icyo ari cyo, aramubohora ategeka abatambyi bakuru guterana n'abanyarukiko bose, amanura Pawulo amushyira imbere yabo.
